Middle East Expansion For Global Clients

Connecting global markets for successful innovative, efficient, and reliable trade solutions.

Founded in 2013 by Izzy Haikin, ISPAL is a boutique firm that delivers strategic and operational solutions to the most complex challenges in international trade and supply chain management.

 

Specializing in the Middle East and Arab world, we are the gateway for global companies looking to expand, operate, and thrive in these dynamic markets.

What We Offer

(01)

Supply Chain Solutions

We focus on solving complex supply chain issues by identifying alternative import/export routes and developing flexible, efficient logistics strategies. Whether dealing with regulatory obstacles or infrastructure constraints, our team offers customized solutions that keep your operations moving smoothly.

(02)

International Trade Relations

ISPAL builds and maintains strategic business relationships with domestic and international partners. With extensive industry knowledge and a regional approach, we assist clients in opening, maintaining, and expanding new trade channels across various sectors.

(03)

Business Development Consulting

Our experienced consultants provide practical insights in strategic planning, market entry, marketing, and business operations. From concept to implementation, we help position your business for sustainable growth in competitive markets.

(04)

International Shipping

We offer fast, secure, and adaptable shipping services worldwide. Utilizing innovative routing and customized service models, we guarantee timely and dependable delivery for all types of shipments.

(05)

End-to-End Logistics

From import/export procedures to managing complete supply chains, we deliver comprehensive logistics support that boosts productivity and ensures compliance. Our solutions are designed to optimize your entire operational process. Regulatory & Standards Compliance ISPAL handles all regulatory approvals and standard certifications required for international trade. We ensure your business remains compliant and market-ready, with minimal delays and maximum efficiency.

Our Guiding Principles

Our Purpose

To empower our clients with innovative, reliable, and region-specific supply chain solutions that unlock new growth, optimize operational efficiency, and drive sustainable economic value across global markets.

Our Vision

To be the leading partner of choice for businesses navigating complex trade and logistics challenges in the Middle East, delivering clarity, speed, and execution where it matters most.

Our Values

At ISPAL, our values define not just how we work, but why we exist. We hold ourselves to the highest standards, commit to measurable outcomes, and treat our clients' goals as our own. Our strength lies in the deep trust we build, the precision we deliver, and the results we create—together.
